title: Pin addressing and custody decisions
description: Record Mark's current clarifications: all routable IPv6 addressing must be upstream-compatible Yggdrasil, not a custom SHA512 native profile; custody delivery remains best effort, with MUST requirements defining conforming node behavior rather than enforceable guarantees. Scope is decision ledger, agent guidance and existing Beads alignment; no runtime or fixture migration during this design discussion.
design: Append adjudicated decisions to spec/decisions.jsonl; mirror focused guidance in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md; annotate existing upstream-address migration tasks and persistent memory. Distinguish Yggdrasil /7 aggregate, /8 node space with /128 identities, and /8 subnet space with /64 allocations. Preserve standard link-local/multicast control. Do not reopen upstream compatibility or invent a substitute profile. Avoid implying compliance or delivery is enforceable against failed or malicious custodians.
acceptance_criteria: Both user decisions recorded without overclaiming implementation completion; instruction files agree; existing addressing work no longer treats custom SHA512 vectors as authority; JSONL parses and focused doc diff checks pass.
